title: Two Cats, Zero Pounds (Genesis at 3 AM)
lyrics:
[Intro]
(ambient rain against bedroom windowpane, analog vinyl crackle)
(quiet breath intake)
Mmm... 
(soft feline purr curled up on the desk)
Yeah... David Liniker, 3 AM in the lab again.
(gentle throat clear)
Levels are good. Let's run it.

[Verse 1]
(hushed half-spoken delivery, intimate warmth)
Two feline landlords staring right at my screen
Judging every chord progression in between
One's asleep across the spacebar, stretching out a pause
The other's tapping at an empty bowl with velvet claws.
Got three pence in the bank, overdraft in red
Selling twenty-dollar dreams when I should be in bed
Streaming pays a fraction of a cent per spin
While I'm pouring out my soul just to break back in
Tenth demo bounced to an A&R's ghost
Sent another quiet prayer to the industry post
Tuna cans stacked where my Grammys oughta sit
Frayed headphone cable, but I don't care a bit.

[Pre-Chorus]
(subtle dual-tracked breathy harmony)
Look at the red lights flashing on the rack
No safety net, no turning back
They want synthetic, they want clean
I'm painting warmth in the midnight green.

[Chorus]
(warm relaxed melodic vocal, behind-the-beat swing)
Mmm... let the pennies roll slow
(two cats, zero pounds, and an old radio)
Ooh... we're gonna make it out the cold
(one more hook before the night grows old)
They buy the plastic, but I'm crafting soul
David on the keys while the tape reels roll...

[Verse 2]
(close-mic intimate delivery, soft rasp)
Got electrical tape holding down the preamp jack
Whispering my verses so the neighbors don't attack
Sixty-four gigs of RAM, but the cupboards are bare
Still got a sixteenth-note swing in the midnight air
Liniker the optimist, broke upon the keys
Looking for a cadence that sets my spirit free
My tabby gave a meow like a pitch-correct chime
Told me keep the pocket and we'll hit it on the time
They don't care 'bout charts or a platinum plaque
Long as there's a lap and a blanket on their back.

[Bridge]
(tape flutter, acoustic Rhodes chords, rain tapping)
Rain keeps drawing bars across the window pane...
A million unsigned voices trying to do the same...
I've got no manager, no advance in hand...
Just nine lives between us...
And a four-chord plan.

[Chorus]
(warm layered vocal, relaxed groove)
Mmm... let the pennies roll slow
(two cats, zero pounds, and an old radio)
Ooh... we're gonna make it out the cold
(one more hook before the night grows old)
They buy the plastic, but I'm crafting soul
David on the keys while the tape reels roll...

[Outro]
(soft purring sound, sleepy keyboard clicks)
(whispered)
Hey, move off the fader, buddy... that's my master bus.
Goodnight, boys.
Mmm... Liniker on the track.
(unresolved D flat major 9 chord rings out and dissolves softly into tape hiss)

title: Feline Landlords on the Spacebar
lyrics:
[Intro]
(needle drop, cozy vinyl hiss)
Mmm... don't touch that button...
(cat step on mechanical keyboard: *click-clack*)
Hey! David Liniker, take two...

[Verse 1]
Walking 'cross the keys like you own the lease
Two feline landlords disturbing my peace
Tabby hit the mute switch right before the drop
Tuxedo in the corner saying: "Make it stop."
Got empty coffee mugs and an overdue light
Twelve hours deep in the groove tonight
They don't care about a contract or a sync deal
Just want a warm spot on the master reel.

[Chorus]
Feline landlords dancing on the spacebar
Judging every loop from near and far
Zero in the bank, but the bassline tight
Two purring kings in the studio light.

[Verse 2]
I tried to track a vocal, hit the record head
Tabby sat right down where the cables lead
Gave a sleepy yawn in the middle of my take
Turned my sad ballad to a cozy coffee break
They're the toughest critics that an artist ever knew
If it isn't funky, they'll just chew upon my shoe.

[Outro]
Yeah... good job on that snare, buddy.
Liniker on the keys...
(purring fades into dusty tape delay)

title: Overdraft Love Letter
lyrics:
[Intro]
(phone notification chime, quiet sigh)
Dear Banking App... I know you miss me...
Yeah...

[Verse 1]
Got a notification that I shouldn't have read
Minus four hundred in the glowing red
I sent an invoice out three weeks ago
To an indie label moving way too slow
My cats are dining on the finest salmon pate
While I split a single egg at the break of day
They look at me like: "David, where's the second course?"
Broke musician life with no remorse.

[Chorus]
Oh, an overdraft love letter sent in the mail
Chasing down dreams on a paper trail
They say get a real job, but I just smile
Got twenty new tracks in the export file.

[Verse 2]
Interest accumulating at the stroke of twelve
Stacking up the vinyls on a secondhand shelf
Every single penny poured into this sound
Someday this little room will shake the ground.

[Outro]
(soft Rhodes chords fade into rain)
Liniker... still here.
Goodnight.

title: Coffee Stains & Broken Preamps
lyrics:
[Intro]
(kettle boiling, tape hum)
Three spoons of instant... black as midnight.

[Verse 1]
Coffee ring circles on the interface wood
Preamp only works when the cable's angled good
Wiggle it a millimeter to the left or right
Or the stereo channel drops clean out of sight
Liniker engineering with a roll of tape
Every broken knob is a chance to reshape.

[Chorus]
Coffee stains and broken preamps keeping the beat
Dusty room magic right off the street
Who needs the million-dollar console shine
When the soul is pure and the groove is mine?

[Outro]
(gentle hiss of the tape head closing)
Just keep it tilted... right there.

title: Sent to an A&R's Ghost
lyrics:
[Intro]
(keystrokes, email whoosh sound)
Private SoundCloud link... sent. Again.

[Verse 1]
"Dear Executive, hope this email finds you well"
Another formal letter in a personal hell
Zero listens on the counter after forty days
Ghosted by the industry in twenty different ways
Cats are asleep on the warm power brick
Told me don't worry 'bout their algorithmic trick.

[Chorus]
Sent to an A&R's ghost in the dark
Leaving a melody, leaving a mark
They didn't click play, but the universe heard
David Liniker on every single word.

[Outro]
(reverb tail rings out into the rain)
Their loss, boys. Next track.

title: Tuna Can Grammys
lyrics:
[Intro]
(can opener sound, rhythmic clinking)
And the award for Best Bedroom Producer goes to...

[Verse 1]
Stacking empty tuna cans four stories tall
Makeshift trophy sitting by the bedroom wall
Tabby gave a nod like an academy peer
"Best Snare Tuning of the Entire Year"
Gold plated aluminum, gourmet chicken feast
Feeding my companions while I feed the beast.

[Chorus]
Tuna Can Grammys shining in the dim
Two feline fans singing on the rim
We don't need a red carpet or a limousine
We're royal sovereigns of the late-night scene.

[Outro]
Thank you to my cats, my interface, and the coffee pot.

title: Four Chords, Nine Lives
lyrics:
[Intro]
(acoustic guitar harmonics, warm sub hum)
D flat major... B flat minor... G flat... A flat. That's home.

[Verse 1]
Four chords on repeat till the daylight starts
Stitching together these broken parts
Nine lives between us in this tiny space
Purring away every worry from my face
Money comes and money goes like winter rain
Music is the medicine that eases the strain.

[Chorus]
Four simple chords and nine little lives
That's how the midnight dreamer survives
No riches to boast, no diamonds to show
Just melodies keeping our spirits aglow.

[Outro]
(fingerpicked guitar rings out softly)
Nine lives... forever.

title: The Space Between Paychecks (Interlude)
lyrics:
[Instrumental Solo Piano & Bedroom Ambiance]
(Soft upright piano chords drifting through warm spring reverb)
(Distant rain on windowpane, steady vinyl crackle)
(Whispered monologue)
"It's not about the money... it's about what you leave behind in the sound."
(Two quiet cat purrs harmonize with a sustained D flat major 9 chord)

title: Bedroom Platinum
lyrics:
[Intro]
(punchy 808 sub thump, hi-hat roll)
They ask where I record... right next to my pillow.

[Verse 1]
RTX humming like an engine in the back
Sixty-four gigs pushing every audio track
No Abbey Road engineers, no fancy acoustic tiles
Just mattress on the wall and a folder full of files
Liniker cooking up a certified classic
Turning humble circumstances into something magic.

[Chorus]
Bedroom Platinum, certified gold
The realest stories that have never been told
From an empty pocket to the top of the shelf
Created by a man who believed in himself.

[Outro]
Straight from the bedroom to the world.

title: Cat Hair on the Pop Filter
lyrics:
[Intro]
(blowing sound on microphone capsule: *pfft-pfft*)
*cough* Hold on... orange fur on the capsule again.

[Verse 1]
Black mesh circle looking like a woolen sweater
Every time I clean it off, the cats say make it better
Rubbing their cheeks right against the metal stand
Official vocal coaches of the Liniker band
Warm high-frequency filter, natural roll-off smooth
Cat hair on the mic capsule adding to the groove.

[Chorus]
Cat hair on the pop filter, purrs in the mix
Analog problems that you never need to fix
Organic texture that you cannot synthesize
Pure bedroom love right before your eyes.

[Outro]
Leave it on. Sounds warmer anyway.

title: Streaming for Pennies
lyrics:
[Intro]
(calculator tapping sound, chuckled sigh)
Point zero zero three... multiplied by ten thousand...

[Verse 1]
Ten thousand spins for a twenty-pound note
Barely enough to buy a winter coat
Or three boxes of litter and a can of stew
Still wouldn't trade this for a nine-to-five view
Because one kid in Tokyo is listening right now
Nodding his head to the Liniker sound.

[Chorus]
Streaming for pennies, but rich in the soul
Letting the tape reels steadily roll
They measure success in the coins that you hold
I measure mine in the stories we've told.

[Outro]
Worth every single fraction of a penny.

title: 4 AM Epiphany
lyrics:
[Intro]
(lush analog synth pad swelling, clock ticking)
4:02 AM. That moment when the noise stops.

[Verse 1]
The traffic is silent, the city is asleep
The melody's floating from the shadows so deep
Finger finds the chord that was missing all along
The missing puzzle piece of a ten-year song
Tuxedo opened one eye, gave a little meow
Told me: "That's the hook, David. Record it right now."

[Chorus]
4 AM epiphany falling from the sky
Wiping the midnight exhaustion from my eye
When the stars align on an old Rhodes key
The whole universe opens up for me.

[Outro]
(synth pad resolves to soft electric piano)
Got it. It's in the bag.

title: Whispering in the Mic (Don't Wake the Neighbors)
lyrics:
[Intro]
(whispered ASMR tone, extremely close to capsule)
Shh... Mrs. Higgins in 4B is sleeping. Keep it low.

[Verse 1]
Paper-thin walls in this old council flat
If I yell on the hook, there's an angry broom tat
So I lean into the grille, keep it hushed and sweet
Turned my noise restrictions to an intimate beat
Velvet whispered cadence floating in the air
Sounds like a confession in a midnight prayer.

[Chorus]
Whispering in the mic so the neighbors don't complain
Turning quiet bedroom secrets into falling rain
Sometimes the softest voice carries furthest away
Speaking to the hearts that are waiting for the day.

[Outro]
(hushed breath, distant siren)
Night, Mrs. Higgins.

title: Bounced to MP3
lyrics:
[Intro]
(export progress bar sound, cheerful Rhodes bounce)
Command-B. Render offline. 100 percent.

[Verse 1]
Export complete on the master bus
No more tweaking, no more fuss
Put it on the phone, put the earbuds in
Walking around the block with a quiet little grin
Two cats at the window watching me depart
Carrying sixteen pieces of my heart.

[Chorus]
Bounced to MP3, fresh out the oven
Packed with dedication and a whole lot of lovin'
From 3 AM darkness to a morning shine
David Liniker's signature on the bottom line.

[Outro]
Sounds great on the ear-pods. Done.

title: Two Little Purrs in the Monitor Mix
lyrics:
[Intro]
(pure acoustic Rhodes and low-passed bass)
(rhythmic, soothing cat purr embedded into the sub frequencies)
Mmm... feel that low end...

[Verse 1]
Forty Hertz vibration, sixty Hertz glow
Two little purrs in the bottom row
Natural LFO oscillating so sweet
Puts a sleepy smile on the late-night street
Safe in the warmth of our little cocoon
Drifting beneath a waning winter moon.

[Chorus]
Two little purrs in the monitor mix
The sweetest lullaby that ever was fixed
Nothing in the world could disturb us tonight
Wrapped in the magic of the audio light.

[Outro]
(peaceful purring dissolving into spring reverb)
Rest easy, boys.

title: Sunrise on the Interface (Outro)
lyrics:
[Intro]
(morning birds chirping outside, golden synth chords)
Look at that... daylight through the blinds.

[Verse 1]
Golden sunlight hitting the fader knobs
Time for the world to go off to their jobs
I've got bags under my eyes and a full album done
Sixteen soulful tracks under the rising sun
Tabby stretched his paws, Tuxedo gave a purr
"Breakfast time, David. We did it, sir."

[Chorus]
Sunrise on the interface, morning in the room
We survived the darkness and we conquered the gloom
David Linacre, signing off the reel
Until the next midnight when we capture the feel.

[Outro]
(warm D flat major chord rings out with birdsong)
Liniker... out.
Time to feed the cats.
(tape click, kettle boil, fade out)
